name: Paolo Marzotto
features: olive skin, dark hair neatly parted, dark eyes, narrow aristocratic face, slim build, easy patrician manner
bio: The youngest and quickest of the four Marzotto brothers, heirs to a Veneto textile fortune, who between them entered the Mille Miglia in Ferraris throughout the 1950s and turned the gentleman driver into something formidable. Paolo finished the great road race just once in eight attempts — fourth in 1951 — and drove a works Ferrari 375 Plus at Le Mans in 1954 and 1955 alongside Umberto Maglioli.
